name: Prusa MK3S (Prusa-Firmware)
startScript:
M201 X1000 Y1000 Z200 E5000 ; maximum accelerations, mm/sec^2
M203 X200 Y200 Z12 E120 ; maximum feedrates, mm/sec
M204 S1250 T1250 ; print and retract acceleration, mm/sec^2
M205 X8.00 Y8.00 Z0.40 E4.50 ; jerk limits, mm/sec
M205 S0 T0 ; minimum extruding and travel feed rate, mm/sec
M907 E538 ; extruder motor current, mA
M221 S100 ; extrusion multiplier 100% — Grackle's E values are the truth
M107 ; part fan off until a Fan operation asks otherwise
endScript:
G1 E-2 F2100 ; retract the filament tip so it stops oozing
G1 X0 Y200 F3000 ; bed forward, head left — the part comes to you
G4 ; drain the planner queue before the motors let go
M900 K0 ; reset linear advance
M221 S100 ; reset the extrusion multiplier
M84 ; steppers off
